data.name: Munjiyah
data.gender_notes: Munjiyah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'najja' meaning safety, security, salvation. Munjiyah signifies the one who brings sweetness and delight, often through her kindness, wisdom, and trustworthiness. The name Munjiyah carries the meaning “Sweetness, Delight” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Munjiyah usually hope their child will grow to embody sweetness, delight and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A symbol of Allah's mercy and compassion, Munjiyah is a reminder of the sweetness and delight found in the faith.
data.etymology: Munjiyah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Sweetness, Delight.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Munjiyah total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.
